# Helix Design System — LLM Index

> Helix DS · v0.1.0 · Built on shadcn/ui + Tailwind CSS v4 + Tabler Icons

## Quick reference

- Scope: @helix-ds
- Token prefix: --helix-
- Data prefix: data-helix-
- Prop vocabulary: .ai/maps/prop-map.md

## Packages

- @helix-ds/tokens  — Design tokens (CSS vars + TS constants)
- @helix-ds/core    — UI components (Button, Input, Badge, Card, Dialog, Select)
- @helix-ds/icons   — Tabler Icons wrapper with size/color tokens

## Components

Status (draft / beta / stable) is computed per component — see contracts/stability.json (ADR-018).

- Button    — Actions, CTAs. Variants: primary secondary ghost danger. Sizes: xs s m l xl.
- Input     — Text fields, search. States: default error disabled. Supports icon, iconEnd.
- Badge     — Status, counts. Variants: neutral success warning danger info.
- Card      — Content grouping. Has header, body, footer slots.
- Dialog    — Modal overlay with trigger, title, description, footer.
- Select    — Dropdown with option groups, search, multi-select.

## Token categories

- color.fill.*    — Background fills (primary, secondary, danger, success, warning, info, neutral)
- color.text.*    — Text colors (default, secondary, disabled, inverse, danger, success)
- color.border.*  — Border colors (default, focus, danger, strong)
- spacing.*       — 4px-based scale (1→20)
- radius.*        — none xs s m l xl full
- shadow.*        — none xs s m l xl
- fontSize.*      — xs s m l xl 2xl 3xl 4xl
- fontWeight.*    — regular medium semibold bold

## Contracts (machine-readable component specs)

- contracts/components/Button.json
- contracts/components/Input.json
- contracts/components/Badge.json
- contracts/components/Card.json
- contracts/components/Dialog.json

## Design patterns (machine-readable)

- .ai/maps/patterns/empty-state.md      — Empty list/table with icon + title + actions
- .ai/maps/patterns/form-field-group.md — Full form with validation state management
- .ai/maps/patterns/action-bar.md       — Page header CTAs + batch selection actions
- .ai/maps/patterns/status-row.md       — Badge variant → semantic meaning mapping
- .ai/maps/patterns/search-filter.md    — Search Input + filter chip Buttons (not Badge)

## Storybook

- apps/storybook/  — Storybook 8 (React + Vite)
- stories live co-located: packages/core/src/components/**/*.stories.tsx
- pattern stories:  apps/storybook/stories/Patterns.stories.tsx
- dev server: pnpm --filter @helix-ds/storybook dev  (port 6006)

## AI context

- CLAUDE.md             — Short agent contract (root)
- AGENTS.md             — Consumer-facing agent guide
- .ai/skills/           — Task-specific skills (SPORT format)
- .ai/agents/           — Specialized agent definitions
- .ai/memory/           — Accumulated lessons from sessions
- .ai/maps/prop-map.md  — Canonical prop vocabulary
- contributor-ai/       — Context for DS contributors
